title: Document orchestration-only dispatcher boundary
summary: Publish the dispatcher as an orchestration-only, no-route contract and document PowerShell production ownership.
reason: Prevent modeled mutation DTOs from becoming generic Local API or frontend mutation capability.
behavior_before: The public contract did not explicitly state that stage execution has no Local API route or that disabled mutation DTOs are descriptive only.
behavior_after: The Local API contract, architecture, inventory, and generated map prohibit generic stage execution and reserve production mutation ownership for MediaPipeline.ps1.
rollback_plan: Revert the public contract and documentation records together; no route, UI caller, or filesystem mutation was added.
notes:
Publish orchestration-only dispatcher boundary.
Document production PowerShell ownership.
Document no dispatcher API routes.
Record hardened ingest and disabled stages.
Publish descriptive disabled-stage notes.
Refresh guarded ingest contract summary.
Refresh dispatcher runner summary.
Refresh dispatcher API contract summary.
